entities.summary: Gabriel Blamo Snosio Jubwe,, is a Nigerian-born Liberian Roman Catholic prelate who is the Archbishop of the Roman Catholic Archdiocese of Monrovia, Liberia since February 2024. While still a priest, he was appointed Administrator of Monrovia from October 2021 until February 2024. He was appointed bishop by Pope Francis on 28 February 2024. He was consecrated at Monrovia, Archdiocese of Monrovia in Liberia on 4 May 2024.
